parameters.name: NodeType
parameters.description:
Node type, with values:
- **start**: Start point.
- **end**: End point.

parameters.name: PathName
parameters.description:
Path name.

> You can call [ListAvailableAttackPath](~~ListAvailableAttackPath~~) to query the path names.

parameters.name: PathType
parameters.description:
Path type.
> You can call [ListAvailableAttackPath](~~ListAvailableAttackPath~~) to query the path types.

parameters.name: SupportType
parameters.description:
Support type, with values:
- **event**: Attack path alert event.
- **whitelist**: Attack path whitelist.
- **sensitive**: Sensitive assets in the attack path.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas list-support-attack-path-asset --support-type event --node-type end --path-type role_escalation --path-name ecs_get_credential_by_create_login_profile --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
